title: Select Seedance 2.0 from Lovart AI’s model dashboard before generating your…
content:
Select Seedance 2.0 from Lovart AI’s model dashboard before generating your video.  
Build your character by uploading reference media (up to 9 images and 3 video clips) to keep the output aligned with your specific creative vision instead of generic results.  
Write your prompt like a film director by specifying cinematic elements (e.g., dramatic lighting, slow-motion reveal, rain-soaked city street, IMAX quality) to push Seedance 2 toward a cinematic look.  
Generate and refine the result by iterating in plain English after the first generation.
